description.value:
You activate a hardlight exoskeleton projected from your omni-tool, reinforcing your body with a crackling energy shell that detonates if overwhelmed.

You gain the Tech Armor effect: +2 circumstance bonus to AC. If you take 20 or more damage from a single hit while this effect is active, it detonates — all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10-foot emanation} take @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|basic|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-armor-detonation] save against the creature's power DC) and the effect ends. You may also voluntarily detonate it as a free action on your turn.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
